name: Gaming Culture and Trivia
description: A set of questions about video game history and culture, development stories, famous bugs and Easter eggs, memes, and esport milestones.

questions.question: What is the name of the famous glitched, endless loop level in Super Mario Bros. reached by phasing through a wall in World 1-2?
questions.explanation_correct: The Minus World is a legendary glitch level in the NES release of Super Mario Bros., designed as a duplicate of World 7-2 but looping indefinitely.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Level 256 is the kill screen in Pac-Man, while the other options are fabricated titles.

questions.question: Which Diablo II Easter egg was directly inspired by a fan rumor about a hidden level in the first Diablo game?
questions.explanation_correct: The Secret Cow Level, filled with halberd-wielding bipedal cows, was Blizzard's response to the viral myth that clicking on cows in Tristram in Diablo I opened a portal.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Whimsyshire is from Diablo III, while the other options are standard in-game locations.

questions.question: What did Pac-Man creator Toru Iwatani claim was the inspiration for the character's iconic shape?
options: A pizza with a single slice missing
questions.answer: A pizza with a single slice missing
questions.explanation_correct: While looking at a whole pizza with a slice removed during a lunch in 1979, Iwatani envisioned the character shape for Pac-Man.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are incorrect myths surrounding the design of the character.

questions.question: What is the historical name given to the EVO 2004 Street Fighter III clip where Daigo Uehara parries Chun-Li's entire special move?
questions.explanation_correct: Evo Moment 37 refers to a legendary comeback by Daigo 'The Beast' Uehara against Justin Wong at Evolution Championship Series 2004.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are informal descriptions and not the recognized title of the video highlight.

questions.question: In which MMORPG did the viral video originate featuring a player shouting his name and charging into a dungeon, ruining his guild's tactical plan?
questions.explanation_correct: The Leeroy Jenkins video was recorded within World of Warcraft inside the Blackrock Spire dungeon, becoming a global internet phenomenon.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The meme was created strictly in World of Warcraft; other MMOs only referenced or parodied it.

questions.question: What coding glitch in the original Civilization game caused the peaceful Indian leader Gandhi to become highly aggressive and nuclear-obsessed?
questions.explanation_correct: Gandhi's base aggression of 1 dropped below zero when adopting Democracy (which reduced it by 2), causing an integer underflow that looped the value to 255.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are standard software crash errors and not the cause of this gameplay behavior.

questions.question: What is the name of Poland's longest-running printed video game magazine, published continuously since 1996?
questions.explanation_correct: CD-Action is Poland's most resilient gaming magazine, famous for including full game discs and its anonymous columnist Smuggler.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Secret Service, Top Secret, and Reset are nostalgic magazines that ceased regular publication years ago.

questions.question: Which famous comic strip license was the game Donkey Kong originally supposed to use before Nintendo lost the rights?
questions.explanation_correct: Nintendo originally wanted to make a game based on Popeye, but when the deal fell through, Shigeru Miyamoto created Jumpman, Pauline, and Donkey Kong.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options were not involved in the production of the 1981 arcade cabinet.

questions.question: What is the name of the famous glitch Pokemon in Pokemon Red and Blue that appears off the coast of Cinnabar Island?
questions.explanation_correct: MissingNo. is a glitch Pokemon used by developers as an exception handler, famous for duplicating the player's sixth item by 128.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Mewthree is a popular playground myth, and the other names are fictional.

questions.question: Which role-playing game is the source of the viral quote: 'I used to be an adventurer like you, then I took an arrow in the knee'?
questions.explanation_correct: The quote is repeated frequently by city guards in Skyrim, quickly becoming a massive internet meme shortly after release.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The quote was written exclusively for Skyrim guards, although other RPGs have referenced it since.

questions.question: What is the name of the Atari 2600 game where designer Warren Robinett hid his name in a secret room, creating the first widely known Easter egg?
questions.explanation_correct: Adventure on Atari 2600 contains the signature of Robinett, who hid it to protest Atari's policy of denying credit to game developers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Pitfall! was designed by David Crane for Activision, and the other games do not contain this historic Easter egg.

questions.question: Why did the developers of Silent Hill include the thick fog, which accidentally became the signature atmosphere of the series?
options: To mask the limited rendering distance of the PlayStation console
To comply with ratings boards censoring gore
As a tribute to John Carpenter's 'The Fog'
Because of a bug in the shadow rendering engine
questions.answer: To mask the limited rendering distance of the PlayStation console
questions.explanation_correct: Team Silent used the fog to hide the technical limitations of the PS1 hardware, turning a rendering restriction into an iconic horror trope.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are incorrect; the choice was driven by hardware draw-distance constraints.

questions.question: What is the in-game alias of Lee Sang-hyeok, the legendary League of Legends mid-laner nicknamed the 'Unkillable Demon King'?
questions.explanation_correct: Faker is widely regarded as the greatest League of Legends player of all time, winning multiple World Championships with T1.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Ruler is an ADC player, and ShowMaker and Chovy are rival Korean mid-lane players.

questions.question: From which Call of Duty game does the viral internet meme 'Press F to pay respects' originate?
options: Call of Duty: Black Ops II
questions.explanation_correct: The prompt appears during the funeral of the protagonist's best friend in Advanced Warfare, criticized for forcing interaction in a cutscene.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While other entries have controversial cutscenes, this specific QTE is unique to Advanced Warfare.

questions.question: The creation of which iconic Minecraft hostile mob was the result of a coding mistake when Notch was trying to model a pig?
questions.explanation_correct: Markus 'Notch' Persson inverted the height and length variables of a pig model, liked the creepy look, and turned it into the exploding Creeper.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Endermen, Zombie Pigmen, and Skeletons were modeled intentionally and not born from coding glitches.

questions.question: What is the name of the 2005 World of Warcraft incident where an infectious debuff spread through virtual cities, studied by epidemiologists?
questions.explanation_correct: The Corrupted Blood incident occurred when a disease debuff from Zul'Gurub spread to cities, acting as a model for real-world pandemic research.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Undead Scourge is lore-based, while the other terms are not the scientific or common name of the incident.

questions.question: What is the pseudonym of the anonymous writer who hosted the 'Action Redaction' letters page in Poland's CD-Action magazine?
questions.explanation_correct: Smuggler was the chief editor of the letters department, whose identity remained a tightly guarded secret for decades.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Eld, Mac Abra, and Qnik were other prominent editors whose real identities were public.

questions.question: Why did Tetris creator Alexey Pajitnov fail to receive royalties for his game during its initial years of global success?
options: The rights were owned by the Soviet Union government
The code was stolen by American arcade companies
He voluntarily signed away all financial claims
Royalties were frozen due to Cold War trade embargoes
questions.answer: The rights were owned by the Soviet Union government
questions.explanation_correct: Pajitnov created Tetris while employed by the Soviet Academy of Sciences, meaning the state owned the intellectual property rights.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The game was licensed legally by the USSR agency Elektronorgtechnica, and Pajitnov only reclaimed rights in 1996.

questions.question: From which RPG does the famous player build 'Giantdad' (accompanied by the line 'The Legend Never Dies') originate?
questions.explanation_correct: Giantdad is a notorious, min-maxed PvP build in Dark Souls created by YouTuber OnlyAfro, spawning countless memes.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The build relies on specific Dark Souls armor items (Mask of the Father and Giant Armor) and cannot exist in other RPGs.

questions.question: What does the sign hidden on top of the Gant Bridge suspension tower in GTA San Andreas say?
options: There are no Easter Eggs up here. Go away.
questions.answer: There are no Easter Eggs up here. Go away.
questions.explanation_correct: Rockstar Games placed the sign 'There are no Easter Eggs up here. Go away.' as a meta-joke referencing players who explore out-of-reach places.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are incorrect variations of this famous hidden text.

questions.question: What is the alias of Lim Yo-hwan, the legendary Terran player who popularized StarCraft in South Korea as the 'Terran Emperor'?
questions.explanation_correct: BoxeR is considered the founding father of South Korean StarCraft esports, achieving massive fame and forming the SK Telecom T1 team.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Flash is a later Terran legend, Jaedong is a Zerg star, and Bisu is a famous Protoss strategist.

questions.question: What mistake by developer Toby Gard led to the exaggerated chest size of Lara Croft in the original 1996 Tomb Raider?
options: Accidentally adjusting the scale slider to 150% instead of 50%
A file conversion error from Amiga to PC models
A prank by another developer swapping the assets
Polygon limitations forcing blocky body proportions
questions.answer: Accidentally adjusting the scale slider to 150% instead of 50%
questions.explanation_correct: Toby Gard slipped his mouse while adjusting the model's dimensions, scaling the breast size to 150% by mistake, which the marketing team insisted on keeping.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The change was not caused by file conversion issues, polygon limits, or developer pranks.

questions.question: From which retro arcade shoot 'em up game does the famous broken English translation 'All your base are belong to us' originate?
questions.explanation_correct: The intro cutscene of Zero Wing features poorly translated dialogue, which became a foundational internet meme of the early 2000s.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While Contra and Gradius are classic scrolling shooters, they did not feature this translation glitch.

questions.question: Why did Mario receive a mustache and a cap in his original design instead of a mouth and hair?
options: Because low-resolution pixels made mouths and hair difficult to render
To copy the authentic look of Italian carpenters at the time
Miyamoto added them to avoid copyright issues with Popeye
US focus groups preferred the mustache over facial features
questions.answer: Because low-resolution pixels made mouths and hair difficult to render
questions.explanation_correct: With limited pixels on early arcade hardware, a mustache was easier to see than a mouth, and a cap saved developers from animating hair.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The design choices were purely technical constraints of early sprite graphics rather than thematic choices.

questions.question: Which country is Joona 'Serral' Sotala, the first non-Korean player to win a StarCraft II World Championship, from?
questions.explanation_correct: Serral is a Finnish professional Zerg player who broke South Korea's historic dominance in StarCraft II competition.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While Sweden and Germany have strong esports players, Serral represents Finland.

questions.question: Which Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Easter egg is hidden on top of a mountain in Toussaint, viewable only with a PC free-camera mod?
options: A group photo of the CD Projekt RED development team
A sketch of Geralt of Rivia
A thank-you note carved into stone
questions.answer: A group photo of the CD Projekt RED development team
questions.explanation_correct: On an inaccessible mountain peak in Toussaint, developers placed a canvas containing a photo of the CDPR development team.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The canvas contains a photo of the developers, not a sketch or dinosaur model.

questions.question: Which Dark Souls NPC is directly associated with the gesture and catchphrase 'Praise the Sun'?
questions.explanation_correct: Solaire of Astora is a Warrior of Sunlight who assists the player, famous for his obsession with the Sun and his iconic pose.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Siegmeyer is the Onion Knight, Patches is a recurring trickster, and Artorias is a corrupted boss.

questions.question: What is the name of the gaming journalist who founded and hosts the annual show 'The Game Awards'?
questions.explanation_correct: Geoff Keighley is the host and producer of The Game Awards, which he established to celebrate excellence in the video game industry.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Greg Miller is from Kinda Funny, Jeff Gerstmann is a former GameSpot editor, and IGN Host is generic.

questions.question: Which action game franchise was born from an early version of Resident Evil 4 that was rejected for being too fast-paced?
questions.explanation_correct: Director Hideki Kamiya's prototype for Resident Evil 4 focused on stylized combat, which Shinji Mikami convinced Capcom to release as Devil May Cry.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Onimusha used similar static cameras but was developed separately, and Bayonetta was created years later by PlatinumGames.

questions.question: What did gamers name the hardware failure of the Xbox 360 signaled by red lights around the power button?
questions.explanation_correct: The Red Ring of Death (RRoD) was a fatal hardware failure caused by thermal issues, forcing Microsoft to extend warranties and spend $1.15 billion.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Error 74 was a display code associated with it, while the other terms are not the common name.

questions.question: In which European country did DreamHack, recognized as the world's largest LAN party, originate?
questions.explanation_correct: DreamHack was founded in Sweden in 1994, growing from a school cafeteria meeting into a massive gaming festival.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Though hosted internationally now, Sweden is the historic birthplace of the event.

questions.question: Which 1986 video game is the source of the classic quote 'It's dangerous to go alone! Take this.'?
questions.explanation_correct: An unnamed old man speaks these words to Link in the cave at the very start of the original NES Zelda game.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While Metroid and Castlevania are from the same era, this quote belongs entirely to Zelda.

questions.question: What childhood experience of Shigeru Miyamoto inspired the exploration gameplay in The Legend of Zelda?
options: Exploring fields, forests, and caves near Sonobe
Fishing trips on rivers with his father
questions.answer: Exploring fields, forests, and caves near Sonobe
questions.explanation_correct: Miyamoto based the gameplay of Zelda on his wanderings as a boy in Kyoto Prefecture, particularly discovering a cave with a lantern.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are incorrect interpretations of Miyamoto's childhood anecdotes.

questions.question: Whose severed head is mounted on a spike inside the final boss, Icon of Sin, in Doom II?
questions.explanation_correct: To defeat the Icon of Sin, players must launch rockets into a brain cavity containing a sprite of John Romero's head on a stick.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Romero's head was hidden by the artists as a prank, which he kept in the final game.

questions.question: Which tournament series in Dota 2 is famous for generating record-breaking prize pools funded by player purchases of Battle Passes?
questions.explanation_correct: The International's prize pool grew dynamically each year using crowdfunding, with the 2021 edition peaking at over $40 million.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While Majors are official, they do not feature the scale of TI's crowdfunding mechanics.

questions.question: What phrase is used as a post-hypnotic trigger to control the protagonist's actions in the original BioShock?
questions.explanation_correct: The phrase 'Would you kindly' was implanted into Jack's mind, forcing him to follow any order preceded by those words.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other choices are not the hypnotic phrase featured in Andrew Ryan's monologue.

questions.question: Which animal is revealed to be controlling the events of the game from a high-tech control room in Silent Hill 2's joke ending?
questions.explanation_correct: The 'Dog Ending' features a Shiba Inu wearing headphones mixing tracks and watching James's life on CRT television monitors.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While the UFO ending features aliens, the control-room joke ending is run by a dog.

questions.question: Which former Nintendo of America president uttered the famous words 'My body is ready' at E3 2007?
questions.explanation_correct: Reggie Fils-Aimé said the phrase before stepping onto the Wii Balance Board, spawning a massive internet meme template.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Miyamoto and Iwata were on stage, but Reggie spoke the line. Bowser is his successor.

questions.question: What was the name of the premier annual video game trade show held in Los Angeles, which officially shut down in 2023?
questions.explanation_correct: E3 (Electronic Entertainment Expo) was the industry's centerpiece event until declining attendance and cancellations led to its permanent closure in 2023.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Gamescom is based in Germany, Tokyo Game Show is in Japan, and PAX is a consumer festival.

questions.question: What is the name of the distorted terrain generator zone at the edge of the world in older versions of Minecraft?
questions.explanation_correct: The Far Lands are an area generated when the noise generators lose computational precision, creating giant wall-like grid formations.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The End is a standard dimension, while the other terms are incorrect placeholder names.

questions.question: What was Lara Croft's original name and nationality in Toby Gard's first design document?
options: She was always Lara Croft from Britain
questions.explanation_correct: Toby Gard originally envisioned Laura Cruz, a tough military woman, but publisher Eidos wanted a UK character, so they picked 'Croft' from a phone book.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are fictional names not present in the Tomb Raider design archives.

questions.question: What text appears in the center of the screen when the player character dies in the Dark Souls series?
questions.explanation_correct: The red-lettered 'YOU DIED' screen is synonymous with FromSoftware's gameplay loop, warning players of their loss of souls.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Game Over is generic, and Wasted is the death screen used in Grand Theft Auto games.

questions.question: Which Team Fortress character class was added because of a bug that colored a player as a member of the opposite team?
questions.explanation_correct: The Spy class was inspired by a bug in Quake TF where a player's name appeared in the enemy team's color, leading to disguise mechanics.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other classes were designed from the start and did not originate from texture or color bugs.

questions.question: What is the alias of Jonathan Wendel, the early professional gamer who dominated Quake and Painkiller tournaments?
questions.explanation_correct: Fatal1ty was one of the first highly successful professional video gamers, licensing his alias for gaming hardware lines.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Thresh won John Carmack's Ferrari, while Rapha and Cooller are champions of later Quake eras.

questions.question: Which famous April Fool's joke in Polish gaming media convinced readers of the existence of a high-tech RPG based on the comic 'Kajko i Kokosz'?
options: Review of a fictional RPG 'Kajko i Kokosz: In the Land of Borostwory'
An announcement of a Polish Fallout clone
A cover disc claiming to contain Witcher 1 demo in 2000
An article about free Pegasus consoles distribution
questions.answer: Review of a fictional RPG 'Kajko i Kokosz: In the Land of Borostwory'
questions.explanation_correct: In April 1999, CD-Action published a detailed fake review of a Kajko i Kokosz RPG, complete with screenshots and ratings, prank-mailing many readers.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options were not the focus of this legendary print magazine hoax.

questions.question: What chicken meal does Leeroy Jenkins mention at the end of the viral video after causing his entire guild's death?
questions.explanation_correct: After hearing his angry guild members complain about the wipe, Schulz finishes the clip with the legendary line 'At least I have chicken.'
questions.explanation_incorrect: The quote specifically names 'chicken' rather than KFC or dinner.

questions.question: Who was the lead game designer responsible for the legendary asymmetric balance of StarCraft: Brood War?
questions.explanation_correct: Rob Pardo served as the designer of Brood War, fine-tuning unit interaction to yield competitive gameplay.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Browder and Kim balanced StarCraft II, and Chris Metzen was the chief lore/story writer.

questions.question: Which sea creature appears as a rare Easter egg in Assassin's Creed II when looking into the water in the flooded Auditore vault?
questions.explanation_correct: Standing near the water in the assassin tomb triggers a cutscene where a giant squid swims past and attacks.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are incorrect; only the giant squid features in this hidden trigger.

questions.question: Which mechanic in Street Fighter III made Daigo's parry defense in 'Evo Moment 37' exceptionally difficult compared to standard blocking?
options: Requiring pressing forward/down precisely as the hit connects
Requiring hitting punch and kick buttons simultaneously
Consuming a full meter of EX bar for each block
Using frame data that requires pausing the game
questions.answer: Requiring pressing forward/down precisely as the hit connects
questions.explanation_correct: Parrying in SFIII requires tap-forward (or tap-down for lows) within a tight 10-frame window, exposing the player to damage if they miss the timing.
questions.explanation_incorrect: EX meters are not consumed, and button inputs are not used for parrying in Street Fighter III.

questions.question: In which iconic puzzle platformer game did the wall graffiti 'the cake is a lie' first appear?
questions.explanation_correct: The phrase 'the cake is a lie' was written by Doug Rattmann in hidden alcoves of Aperture Science, warning players that GLaDOS's reward was fake.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Although set in the same universe as Half-Life, this quote is unique to Portal.

questions.question: Which historical leader in the Civilization series became a meme representing nuclear war due to a programming bug in the first game?
questions.explanation_correct: Mahatma Gandhi, despite his pacifist real-life legacy, became an aggressive nuclear war-monger in the game due to an underflow error.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other leaders had high aggression rates programmed by default, rather than by software glitches.

questions.question: What technical reason caused the aliens in Space Invaders (1978) to accelerate as the player destroyed them?
options: The reduction in rendering load allowed the hardware processor to run faster
It was a deliberate difficulty scaling algorithm written in the code
A game loop bug that skipped frame delays
Technical limitations of cathode-ray tube monitors
questions.answer: The reduction in rendering load allowed the hardware processor to run faster
questions.explanation_correct: The processor was overloaded by rendering many alien sprites. As they died, the system could draw sprites faster, which developer Tomohiro Nishikado kept as a gameplay feature.
questions.explanation_incorrect: It was not a pre-programmed speed-up curve, but an accidental hardware behavior left in by the designer.

questions.question: Which South Korean cable channel was the first to broadcast professional StarCraft matches and establish leagues in 2000?
questions.explanation_correct: OnGameNet (OGN) pioneered televised esports, producing professional leagues like the Starleague for over a decade.
questions.explanation_incorrect: MBCGame was a rival channel launched later, while SBS and KBS are mainstream networks.

questions.question: For which home console was the version of Zero Wing containing the famous translated intro cutscene released?
questions.explanation_correct: The poorly translated opening scene was exclusive to the 1991 European port of Zero Wing on the Sega Mega Drive.
questions.explanation_incorrect: SNES and NES did not receive ports, and the PC Engine CD version featured a redone opening in Japanese.

questions.question: Which object did players need to carry in Atari's Adventure to unlock the barrier leading to Warren Robinett's hidden name?
questions.explanation_correct: The Easter egg is triggered by finding a single-pixel object called 'the Dot' in the Cat's Eye Labyrinth and bringing it to the gold castle corridor.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Keys, swords, and chalices are regular quest items used to solve the main game rather than trigger the easter egg.

questions.question: What is the common term for Pac-Man's level 256 screen crash that corrupts the right half of the display with random symbols?
questions.explanation_correct: The level 256 glitch, or split-screen, occurs because Pac-Man's 8-bit level register overflows when drawing the fruit icons at the bottom.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are generic computer terms and not the historic arcade slang.

questions.question: Which Korean mid-laner (alias Ryu) was Faker's opponent during the legendary 'Zed vs Zed' outplay in the 2013 OGN Finals?
questions.explanation_correct: Faker outplayed Ryu (Yoo Sang-wook) in a blind-pick mirror match in the 5th game of the HOT6iX Champions Summer 2013 Finals.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Crown, Ambition, and Pawn are other world champions who did not play in this specific 2013 duel.

questions.question: Which character stat in Dark Souls does the Giantdad meme video tell players to never level up or admit to leveling?
questions.explanation_correct: The video tells players: 'Don't tell anyone you leveled that up, you casual' in reference to Dexterity, joking about strength build elitism.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Strength and Vitality are actually promoted in the build to wield the Chaos Zweihander.

questions.question: Which Dutch video game designer and entrepreneur secured the handheld rights to Tetris for Nintendo's Game Boy, visiting Moscow in 1989?
questions.explanation_correct: Henk Rogers bypassed traditional channels to negotiate directly in Moscow, securing the Game Boy bundle contract that drove Tetris to global success.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Pajitnov was the creator, Stein was a rival negotiator, and Lincoln was Nintendo of America's legal counsel.

questions.question: What popular fan theory explains the phrase 'arrow in the knee' as a Norse slang term for a specific life event?
questions.explanation_correct: A viral rumor claimed that taking an arrow to the knee was Norse slang for getting married, though Bethesda developers confirmed it was just a literal line about an injury.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other theories were not widely spread as explanation myths for the guard dialogue.

questions.question: What is the name of the world's premier biannual charity speedrunning marathon event?
questions.explanation_correct: Games Done Quick (GDQ) is a massive charity marathon where speedrunners show off their skills to raise money for charity.
questions.explanation_incorrect: ESA is the European equivalent, while the other choices are fictitious speedrunning leagues.

questions.question: In which US state did Atari bury thousands of unsold cartridges of E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial in a landfill in 1983?
questions.explanation_correct: Atari buried surplus game cartridges in an Alamogordo, New Mexico landfill, which was excavated in 2014 for a documentary film.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While Atari was based in California, the physical landfill site was located in New Mexico.

questions.question: What is the name of the secret ending in Silent Hill 2 unlocked by gathering four ritual items, where James attempts to resurrect Mary?
questions.explanation_correct: The Rebirth ending allows James to use ancient dark magic to revive his deceased wife, presenting a supernatural alternative to the main endings.
questions.explanation_incorrect: In Water and Leave are standard emotional endings, and UFO is the sci-fi parody resolution.

questions.question: Which character did Justin Wong play in the historic 'Evo Moment 37' match at EVO 2004?
questions.explanation_correct: Justin Wong played Chun-Li, unleashing her multi-hit Super Art with the expectation of chipping away Daigo's remaining sliver of health.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Daigo played Ken Master, while Ryu and Akuma were not selected for this tournament game.

questions.question: What was the name of the cult Polish gaming magazine published from 1993 to 2001, famous for its layout and the 'Klan' feature?
questions.explanation_correct: Secret Service was a landmark Polish video game magazine that introduced generation of kids to hardware and software reviews.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Gambler and Swiat Gier Komputerowych were rival publications, and Cybermycha targeted younger children.

questions.question: What objects stand on either side of the old man in the cave when he gives Link his sword in The Legend of Zelda?
questions.explanation_correct: The old man is flanked by two fire torches in the cave layout, which has been recreated in countless retro parody memes.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The room contains only the old man, the two fires, and the levitating sword asset.

questions.question: What color is the thick fog in Silent Hill 2, chosen to distinguish it from the grey fog of the first game?
questions.explanation_correct: The fog in Silent Hill 2 has a subtle yellowish, dirty tint, designed to feel sick and decay-like rather than clean grey.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Red, blue, and black fog are incorrect; the main fog filter used is a sickly off-white.

questions.question: Which microprocessor powered the original Space Invaders arcade cabinet in 1978?
questions.explanation_correct: Space Invaders was built using the Intel 8080 Central Processing Unit, which could not manage the processing overhead of moving all aliens at top speed.
questions.explanation_incorrect: MOS 6502 was in the Apple II, Z80 in Pac-Man, and 68000 in newer 16-bit consoles like Genesis.

questions.question: Which South Korean esports organization did BoxeR found in 2004, which remains a powerhouse in LoL and StarCraft today?
questions.explanation_correct: BoxeR founded the team Orion, which secured sponsorship to become SK Telecom T1, the most successful League of Legends team under the name T1.
questions.explanation_incorrect: KT Rolster is T1's historic telecom rival, and the other clubs are defunct or rebranded.

questions.question: Which two rings are mandatory for the Giantdad build in Dark Souls to allow fast-rolling in heavy armor?
options: Ring of Favor and Protection & Havel's Ring
Ring of Fog & Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring
questions.answer: Ring of Favor and Protection & Havel's Ring
questions.explanation_correct: Havel's Ring and the Ring of Favor and Protection (FAP) boost equipment load, enabling the build's agility.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other rings grant damage or stealth bonuses and do not affect character weight parameters.

questions.question: What is the name of the solo programmer who was forced to develop E.T. on Atari 2600 in just five weeks?
questions.explanation_correct: Howard Scott Warshaw coded E.T. in five weeks to meet the Christmas deadline, which ultimately led to the game's poor design and critical panning.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Bushnell founded Atari, Robinett made Adventure, and Alcorn engineered the original Pong arcade cabinet.

questions.question: What does the speedrun category 'Any%' mean, in contrast to the '100%' category?
options: Completing the game as fast as possible with no requirement on collection percentage
Completing the game using only wall-clip out of bounds glitches
Playing the game on the easiest difficulty setting
Beating a random assortment of levels in a custom order
questions.answer: Completing the game as fast as possible with no requirement on collection percentage
questions.explanation_correct: Any% requires the player to reach the game's credits by any means, bypassing side-quests, collectibles, and standard progression.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Glitches may be used depending on sub-rules (Glitchless), but Any% refers strictly to the lack of completion requirements.

questions.question: What did players name the hidden alcoves within testing chambers in Portal containing drawings and canned foods left by a survivor?
questions.explanation_correct: Rattmann Dens are hidden chambers behind panels where Doug Rattmann slept, containing murals depicting the game's lore and GLaDOS's history.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are fan speculation and not the community or canon term.

questions.question: Whose coffin is the player standing before during the 'Press F to pay respects' prompt in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare?
questions.explanation_correct: The funeral is for Will Irons, Mitchell's squadmate and the son of Atlas CEO Jonathan Irons (played by Kevin Spacey).
questions.explanation_incorrect: Cormack and Gideon are alive during the scene, and Jonathan Irons is the CEO attending the service.

questions.question: In which US city did the EVO 2004 tournament take place, hosting the historic 'Evo Moment 37' match?
questions.explanation_correct: EVO 2004 was held at California State Polytechnic University in Pomona, California, before the tournament permanently moved to Las Vegas.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While EVO is now associated with Las Vegas, the 2004 event was hosted in Pomona.

questions.question: Which revolutionary movement mechanic designed by Shigeru Miyamoto in Donkey Kong (1981) gave Mario his original name 'Jumpman'?
questions.explanation_correct: Donkey Kong introduced a dedicated button to jump over rolling barrels, creating the platformer genre blueprint.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Climbing and dodging existed, but the physics-based jump button was the major innovation.

questions.question: What is the name of the designer of Space Invaders who decided to leave the hardware acceleration glitch in the game?
questions.explanation_correct: Tomohiro Nishikado realized the frame-rate speedup enhanced the gameplay tension and decided to treat it as an official game feature.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Iwatani made Pac-Man, Miyamoto designed Mario, and Yokoi created the Game Boy.

questions.question: What was the name of the early Polish video game magazine (1990-1996) published by Bajtek, famous for its humor and editor nicknames like Borek?
questions.explanation_correct: Top Secret was Poland's first print gaming magazine, establishing a specific culture of inside jokes and casual game reviews.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Gambler and Secret Service launched later in 1993, while Reset debuted in 1997.

questions.question: Killing which unique monster in Diablo II's Secret Cow Level (prior to patch 2.4) locked players out of opening the portal again on that difficulty?
questions.explanation_correct: Killing The Cow King permanently set a quest completion flag that prevented that character from hosting the cow level again.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Cow Queen is fictional, while Wirt and the Butcher are located in other game acts.

questions.question: Which greatsword (infused with Chaos or Fire) serves as the primary weapon for the Giantdad build in Dark Souls?
questions.explanation_correct: The build utilizes a Chaos Zweihander +5, relying on humanity scaling to deal heavy physical and fire damage without investing in strength stats.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Claymore is lighter, and the other options require magic or faith scaling not present in Giantdad.

questions.question: What happened to the background audio tempo in Space Invaders as the aliens accelerated?
options: The audio beat tempo accelerated matching the alien movement speed
The audio slowed down to save processing power
The music playback rate remained constant
questions.answer: The audio beat tempo accelerated matching the alien movement speed
questions.explanation_correct: The heartbeat-like bass tones were tied directly to the enemy movement cycles, speeding up as the aliens drew closer.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The audio tempo was dynamic and directly connected to the rendering speeds.

questions.question: What is the name of the red ghost in Pac-Man whose AI algorithm targets the player directly at all times?
questions.explanation_correct: Blinky's AI target tile is Pac-Man's exact location, earning him the nickname 'Shadow' because he follows directly behind.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Pinky attempts to intercept, Inky uses vector calculations with Blinky, and Clyde runs away when close.

questions.question: Which hardware platform was heavily favored by CD-Action in its early years, sparking debates with console/microcomputer fans?
questions.explanation_correct: CD-Action focused entirely on PC CD-ROM gaming, generating letters from Amiga owners who accused the editors of bias.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The magazine's name referenced the CD-ROM drive, which was a PC-centric technology at the time.

questions.question: What is the name of the cyborg villain who speaks the line 'All your base are belong to us' in Zero Wing?
questions.explanation_correct: CATS is the cyborg leader of the enemy forces who delivers the iconic warning in the game's opening sequence.
questions.explanation_incorrect: ZIG is the name of the player's fighter craft, and the other options are incorrect.

questions.question: What happened when players carried transistor radios to specific spots in Portal, added in a pre-Portal 2 teaser update?
options: The radio static changed into encoded SSTV signal transmissions
The radio exploded, destroying nearby security cameras
GLaDOS began singing an alternate version of Still Alive
The player unlocked the hidden 'Baker' achievement
questions.answer: The radio static changed into encoded SSTV signal transmissions
questions.explanation_correct: The update hid radios that broadcast Morse code and Slow-scan television (SSTV) images, teasing the story of Portal 2.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The radios did not explode, and the achievement unlocked was called 'Transmission Received'.

questions.question: What does the esports acronym APM stand for in real-time strategy games like StarCraft?
questions.explanation_correct: APM tracks the total number of inputs a player executes in one minute, serving as a metric for speed and efficiency.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are made-up terms that do not represent the APM metric.

questions.question: What year did Notch write the glitched pig model code that led to the creation of the Creeper in Minecraft's early alpha?
options: Not specified - it occurred during early alpha phase
questions.answer: Not specified - it occurred during early alpha phase
questions.explanation_correct: The code error happened during the early survival development phase of Minecraft, and is celebrated as a happy accident.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are standalone numerical years, which are avoided for correct options.

questions.question: What is the name of the online covenant in Dark Souls whose members summon as golden phantoms and use Solaire's gesture?
questions.explanation_correct: The Warriors of Sunlight covenant rewards players with Sunlight Medals for co-op success, summoned as golden phantoms.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are separate factions with distinct mechanics (PvP invasion or healing).

questions.question: Which Pac-Man ghost (Clyde, the orange one) stops chasing the player and retreats to his corner when getting too close?
questions.explanation_correct: Clyde's AI behavior switches from direct targeting to pathing toward his home corner whenever he is within an 8-tile radius of Pac-Man.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other ghosts maintain their pursuit patterns and do not flee based on proximity.

questions.question: Which counter-attack combo did Daigo's Ken execute immediately after parrying Chun-Li to win the round?
options: Jumping kick, fierce punch, Shoryuken, into Shippu Jinraikyaku Super Art
Light kick followed by a Hadouken
His own Super Art raw without aerial parries
questions.answer: Jumping kick, fierce punch, Shoryuken, into Shippu Jinraikyaku Super Art
questions.explanation_correct: Daigo executed a jump-parry to position himself for an optimal counter combo, finishing with Ken's Shippu Jinraikyaku Super Art.
questions.explanation_incorrect: A throw or light Hadouken would not have dealt enough damage to secure the KO before timeout.

questions.question: In which province of Tamriel is the guard dialogue about the 'arrow in the knee' famously heard in almost every city?
questions.explanation_correct: The dialogue was written specifically for the guards of Skyrim, and does not appear in other Elder Scrolls entries like Oblivion (Cyrodiil) or Morrowind.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The line is not present in Morrowind, Oblivion (Cyrodiil), or Daggerfall (High Rock).

questions.question: What is the name of the Shiba Inu dog who stars in Silent Hill 2's famous joke ending?
questions.explanation_correct: The dog is named Mira, and she has made appearances in other Silent Hill entries as a recurring gag.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are generic Japanese dog names not associated with Silent Hill's dog ending.

questions.question: What was the protagonist of Devil May Cry originally named when the project was still Resident Evil 4?
questions.explanation_correct: Kamiya's early Resident Evil 4 script starred a genetically altered investigator named Tony, who was later renamed Dante.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Dante and Vergil are the final names used in DMC, and Leon S. Kennedy stars in the final RE4 release.

questions.question: Which sport and heavy metal music subculture was editor Eld (Maciej Kuc) famous for promoting in CD-Action magazine?
questions.explanation_correct: Eld was the magazine's sports game reviewer and a vocal fan of soccer, basketball, and metal music.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other sports options do not reflect the editor's public column interests.

questions.question: Which keyboard key on PC computers became the global symbol for the 'Press F to pay respects' meme?
questions.explanation_correct: The letter F on standard QWERTY keyboards became synonymous with mock respect due to the PC version's prompt.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While E and Space are common interact buttons, F is the specific key immortalized by the meme.

questions.question: What does the term 'Glitchless' mean in speedrunning rules and leaderboard categories?
options: Completing the game without using programming glitches, bugs, or out-of-bounds errors
Completing the run without taking any damage (no-hit)
Banning the use of controllers with turbo features
Banning the skipping of in-game story cutscenes
questions.answer: Completing the game without using programming glitches, bugs, or out-of-bounds errors
questions.explanation_correct: Glitchless categories require runners to beat the game using only developer-intended mechanics, banning memory leaks and physics exploits.
questions.explanation_incorrect: No-hit is a different challenge, and hardware rules are managed under general submission guidelines.

questions.question: What is the name of the musician and songwriter who wrote the song 'Still Alive' for Portal's end credits?
questions.explanation_correct: Jonathan Coulton wrote 'Still Alive' specifically for the game, which went on to win multiple game soundtrack awards.
questions.explanation_incorrect: McLain is the voice actress/singer, Bailey composed the ambient music for Half-Life, and Callahan is fictional.

questions.question: Who is James Sunderland actually looking at in the mirror during the opening scene of Silent Hill 2, as discovered by fans brightening the image textures?
options: Directly at the player (breaking the fourth wall)
questions.answer: Directly at the player (breaking the fourth wall)
questions.explanation_correct: Texture extraction and brightening revealed that James's pupils are turned away from his own reflection, staring directly at the camera/player.
questions.explanation_incorrect: He is not staring at Mary, Pyramid Head, or an alternate self; his eyes are directed at the user.

questions.question: What is the grammatically broken line spoken by the Captain upon seeing an explosion in the Zero Wing intro?
options: Somebody set up us the bomb
All your base are belong to us
questions.answer: Somebody set up us the bomb
questions.explanation_correct: The Captain says 'Somebody set up us the bomb' in response to the bridge exploding, a major line in the meme script.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are lines spoken during other parts of the transmission sequence.

questions.question: Which champion (such as Ryze or Azir) is considered Faker's most iconic signature character in competitive League of Legends play?
questions.explanation_correct: Ryze is the champion most closely associated with Faker's early championship runs, honored with an SKT T1 Ryze skin.
questions.explanation_incorrect: While LeBlanc and Zed are pocket picks, Ryze is his definitive signature champion in Worlds history.
